create_CubeRotateZAxis_env: create a CubeRotateZAxis environment for rotating a cube around the z-axis with a leap hand robot
run_domain_randomize: run domain randomization on a mujoco mjx model with randomized friction, mass, inertia, and joint parameters
get_default_config: get the default configuration for the CubeRotateZAxis environment with reward scales and noise settings
reset_CubeRotateZAxis: reset the CubeRotateZAxis environment with randomized hand and cube initial states
step_CubeRotateZAxis: step the CubeRotateZAxis environment forward with an action and return the updated state, observation, and reward
